{{Top}}
[[File:FalconQuadCannon.jpg|thumb|right|250px|One of two quad cannons on the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].]]
{{Quote|Will you look at that? Twin quad lasers. That's, what, a three-year prison sentence right there?|[[Joak Quiller]], concerning the illegal weaponry of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]|<ref name="Allegiance">[[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']]</ref>}}
The '''quad laser cannon''', or '''quadlaser,''' was a type of weaponry commonly used on small [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] such as the [[YT-series/Legends|YT-Series]] of transports (most notably the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]), [[XS stock light freighter/Legends|XS stock light freighters]], or (in theory) [[Dynamic-class freighter/Legends|''Dynamic''-class freighters]].

They varied in size, from the relatively small versions mounted on the ''Millennium Falcon'' to larger variants mounted on smaller warships like the [[Lancer-class frigate/Legends|''Lancer''-class frigate]]. [[BTL-S8 K-wing assault starfighter|K-wing]] assault fighters were armed with quad [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]].

Even heavier [[Quad turbolaser cannon/Legends|quad turbolasers]] were mounted on bigger warships such as the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]] or used as ground artillery.

Quadlasers were illegal under [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] jurisdiction by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], punishable by a considerable prison sentence.<ref name="Allegiance" />

An example of the quad laser cannon was the [[AG-2G quad laser cannon/Legends|AG-2G quad laser cannon]], of which the ''Millennium Falcon'' had two.
